meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行计划,由多个智能体分工推进并持续记录进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果已经排好一份计划,想交给 AI 智能体按步骤执行并保持进度同步
copy.tagline_en: Run your plan with parallel agents and keep progress tracked.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a ready plan and want AI agents to execute it while keeping progress tracked.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 变成“总调度”:它读取 .omo/plans 下的计划文件,把每个待办拆成小任务,分派给多个并行子代理去写代码、测试和审查,自己只负责选计划、记录进度和验收结果,绝不亲手改代码。
howto.when: 在完成规划之后,当你对 Claude 说“start work”“execute plan”等指令,或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的某个计划时触发。

say.text: 开始执行我们刚才定的计划
say.note: Claude 会先选计划并建立任务清单。

say.text: 继续执行计划,从下一个未完成步骤开始
say.note: 它会读取存储的状态恢复未完成工作。

say.text: 用 --make-pr 方式执行 plan-web 重构
say.note: 会在独立工作目录中实现并生成 PR。

howto.what_en: This skill turns Claude into an orchestrator: it reads plan files under .omo/plans, decomposes each todo into small tasks, and dispatches them to parallel subagents for coding, testing and review. Claude only selects plans, records progress and verdicts, and never edits code itself.
howto.when_en: Triggers after planning when you tell Claude "start work", "execute plan", etc., or ask it to run a plan under .omo/plans.

say_en.text: Start executing the plan we just made
say_en.note: It selects the plan and builds the task list.

say_en.text: Continue the plan from the next unfinished step

say_en.note: It implements in a worktree and opens a PR.
